acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves one bounded observation workflow; it does not establish causality, general production readiness, customer acceptance, or business outcomes.
evidenceRequired: The pilot binds its release, journey, signals, counter-signals, window, rollback signal, data owner, privacy limits, and ratifying role.
The report distinguishes product success, agent effectiveness, production observation, customer acceptance, and business outcomes.

completionCriteria: One repository-owner-approved pilot binds a shipped change, release evidence, actor journey, success signals, counter-signals, observation window, rollback signal, data owner, and ratifying human role before observation starts.

Read-only adapters ingest only declared release, analytics, error, support, accessibility, and agent-effectiveness evidence with provenance, timestamp, freshness, retention, privacy, and tenant boundaries.
Missing, stale, contradictory, incomplete, privacy-disallowed, or out-of-window evidence produces NOT_READY or a blocked result, never success.
Product success and agent effectiveness remain separate evaluations, and the assessment makes no causal claim beyond its declared evidence.
A successful assessment can create only a human-required memory candidate; exact ratification permits one append and retirement preserves history.
The pilot report separates local adapter proof, release evidence, production observation, customer acceptance, and business outcome claims.
nonObjectives: Do not create a telemetry warehouse, collect secrets, or export raw personal data.
Do not let a model alter thresholds, decide success, promote memory, or infer causality.
Do not claim a production or customer outcome from local fixtures or deployment evidence alone.
objective: Prove one privacy-bounded, read-only runtime evidence and outcome-learning loop in an authorized consuming repository.
title: Prove a bounded runtime-outcome learning pilot
